verdict.rationale: Training-data opt-out is a fair question for an AI transcription API, but the evidence pack never documents a setting, policy, or contractual guarantee that keeps customer audio or transcripts out of model training. PII redaction and EU data residency are related privacy controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
